title: Crystal Garden
description: Towering prismatic crystals rise from the earth like ancient trees, their faceted surfaces splitting light into cascading rainbows. A low harmonic tone resonates through the formation, and fine crystalline dust drifts in the still air like luminous pollen.

choices.label: Harvest crystal shards
choices.description: Carefully break off smaller growths from the base of the formations.

choices.label: Collect the resonant dust
choices.description: Sweep up the sparkling dust that gathers in the hollows between crystals.

choices.label: Search between the formations
choices.description: Previous visitors may have dropped belongings while mesmerized by the light.

choices.label: Leave the garden undisturbed
choices.description: The crystals seem almost alive. It feels wrong to take from them.
